title: Why Not A Single Brain Network Backs The Left-Brain Myth
hook: You were never a left-brain or right-brain person, and science just proved it.
closing: Your brain works as one team, so you are not a left or right type.
question: Were you labeled left-brained or right-brained?

segments.say: Language really does lean left: about 96 percent of right-handers. But personality has no favorite side, so the myth falls apart.
All 7 networks they checked worked across both sides. None fit the myth, so the idea fails the moment anyone tests it.
About 200 million nerve fibers wire the two halves together, so they swap signals nonstop. Neither side runs you alone.
